name: Winterfall Ritual Totem
objectiveText: Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them. Winterfall Ritual Totem (Provided)  ( 1 )
